crossRefs.note: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
“Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his…
Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood…
It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on…
A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
translations.bsb: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
translations.kjv: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard
translations.asv: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
